2026-12-03.title: Thursday of the First Week of Advent · St Francis Xavier, Priest
readings: Trust in the Lord forever, for the Lord is an everlasting rock
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord
2026-12-03.alt: Memorial of St Francis Xavier, priest, patron of the missions. In the Archdiocese of Goa and Daman it is a solemnity, with proper readings.
2026-12-03.verse: Everyone then who hears these words of mine and acts on them will be like a wise man who built his house on rock.
theo: Jesus ends the Sermon on the Mount with a warning and a picture. Not everyone who says “Lord, Lord” will enter the Kingdom, but the one who does the Father's will. Two houses face the same rain, floods and wind; one stands because it is founded on rock. Isaiah gives the foundation's name: “Trust in the LORD forever, for in the LORD GOD you have an everlasting rock.” Advent is a time to check the foundations.

St Francis Xavier (1506–1552), Jesuit, one of the first companions of St Ignatius, arrived in Goa in 1542 and preached along the coasts of South India, among the Paravas of the Fishery Coast, in Travancore, then in Malacca, the Moluccas and Japan. He died on the island of Shangchuan, within sight of China. His body rests in the Basilica of Bom Jesus in Goa. He built on rock: “Lord, I am here; what do you want me to do?”
outline: Ask: if a storm hit your life tonight, what would hold you up?
Build on God, the everlasting Rock.
A life poured out for the Gospel in India and Asia.
live: Choose one teaching of Jesus you hear but do not do, and act on it this week.
Pray for missionaries from Kerala serving in North India and abroad.
2026-12-03.prayer: Lord Jesus, everlasting Rock, let me not only call you “Lord” but do your will. Build my life on your word, and through the prayers of St Francis Xavier, make me a missionary wherever I am. Amen.
altar: Christ is the rock. At this Mass we hear his word and receive him, so that our lives may be built on him and not on sand.

quick: Saying “Lord, Lord” is not enough; we must do his will.
Build on the Rock, and the storms will not destroy you.
Francis Xavier built his life on Christ and carried him across Asia.
2026-12-03.action: Act on one teaching of Jesus you have been ignoring.
2026-12-03.question: What is my life really built on?

family.explain: Jesus says a wise person builds a house on rock. When we listen to Jesus and do what he says, our lives are strong.
family.intention: We pray for missionaries, especially those from India.
family.ask: Ask: “What is one thing Jesus says that we can do this week?”

pm.open: Lord Jesus, rock of our salvation, you gave St Francis Xavier a heart on fire for the Gospel. As we gather, help us not only to hear your word but to build our lives on it. Amen.
share: Jesus says not everyone who says Lord, Lord will enter (Matthew 7:21). Where is my faith more words than action?
What ‘storms’ have tested the foundations of my life?
What word of Jesus will I put into practice this week?
interc: For missionaries throughout the world, that they may be faithful and fruitful.
For the people of India's coasts, evangelised by St Francis Xavier.
For those whose lives have been shaken by storms, that they may find a firm foundation in Christ.
For vocations to the missionary life.
For our families, that they may be built on the rock of God's word.
pm.close: Lord God, through St Francis Xavier you brought the Gospel to our land. Make us doers of your word, built on the rock of your Son, and give us his zeal to share our faith. Amen.

illus: During the 2018 Kerala floods, an old house built by a grandfather on a raised stone foundation stood untouched while newer houses around it were damaged. The grandson said: “He spent more on what nobody sees: the foundation.”

homily: Dear friends, today we celebrate St Francis Xavier, patron of the missions, who preached along the coasts of South India in the sixteenth century. The Advent readings speak of building on solid ground.

Isaiah sings of a strong city with walls and ramparts: trust in the Lord for ever, for in the Lord God you have an everlasting rock (Isaiah 26:4). The proud city falls, but the poor and the needy walk securely on the rock.

Jesus ends the Sermon on the Mount with a parable. Not everyone who says to me, Lord, Lord, will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father. The one who hears my words and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on rock. The rain fell, the floods came, the winds blew, but the house did not fall (Matthew 7:21, 24–25).

Every Kerala family knows what floods can do. In 2018 we saw houses on weak foundations collapse, while others stood. Jesus says the difference is not in hearing but in doing. Many people hear the Gospel; fewer build their lives on it.

Francis Xavier built on the rock. He heard the words of Jesus, what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and lose his soul, and he acted on them. He left a brilliant career in Paris, and spent himself for the poor fishermen of the Coromandel and Travancore coasts, teaching them the faith in their own language with songs and prayers.

This Advent, let us check our foundations. Is my faith only words, Lord, Lord, or is it action? Let us choose one word of Jesus and put it into practice this week. And let us pray for missionaries, that like St Francis Xavier they may build the Church on the rock of Christ. Amen.
kids: Children, a house on rock does not fall in a storm. When you obey Jesus, you are building on rock. St Francis Xavier did that!

intro: Not words but obedience; God the everlasting Rock; St Francis Xavier, a missionary built on Christ.

sub: The Father's will must be done.
q: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” And I said, “Here am I; send me!”
Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father in heaven.
points.apply: Do one teaching of Jesus you have ignored.

sub: The same storms hit both houses.
q: Those of steadfast mind you keep in peace—in peace because they trust in you. Trust in the LORD forever, for in the LORD GOD you have an everlasting rock.

Everyone then who hears these words of mine and acts on them will be like a wise man who built his house on rock. The rain fell, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house, but it did not fall, because it had been founded on rock.
points.apply: Build a daily habit of reading the Gospel.

sub: He left Europe for India in 1542.
He preached on the coasts of South India.
He died in sight of China.
q: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of the messenger who announces peace, who brings good news, who announces salvation.

Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey everything that I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age.
points.apply: Support a missionary or mission diocese this Advent.

concl: Faith that acts is a house on rock.
Like Xavier, let Christ be our foundation.
2026-12-03.resolve: Give an Advent offering to the missions.
